In [[algebraic geometry]], the '''Fröberg conjecture''' is a [[conjecture]] about the possible [[Hilbert series and Hilbert polynomial|Hilbert function]]s of a set of forms. It is named after {{ill|Ralf Fröberg|sv}}, who introduced it in {{harvs|txt|last=Fröberg |year=1985|loc=page 120}}. The '''Fröberg–Iarrobino conjecture''' is a generalization introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Iarrobino|first=Anthony|year=1997}}.

== Statement of Conjecture ==
Given generic homogeneous polynomials <math> g_1,g_2,\ldots,g_k\in \mathbb{C}[x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n]</math> of degrees <math> a_1,a_2,\ldots, a_k</math>, respectively. Then the Hilbert series of <math>\mathbb{C}[x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n]/\langle g_1,g_2,\ldots, g_k\rangle </math> is 
:<math>  {(1+t+t^2+\cdots)^n}{(1-t^{a_1})(1-t^{a_2})\cdots (1-t^{a_k})}, </math> 
truncated at its first negative term.
